about.heading: The difference is structural, not a claim
about.text:
Most firms assemble this model across several agencies. We deliver it as one integrated firm, with strategy and delivery in the same place, often in the same conversation.

When strategy and delivery live in the same firm, there is no handover to manage between agencies, and no gap where the thinking and the work drift apart.

The coherence is the point. The speed is a by-product of it. And one integrated firm removes much of the coordination overhead the multi-firm model builds in.

method.text: We define the strategy on evidence, activate it across brand, research and people as one, and measure what changes. The method is the same whichever discipline leads, which is how the disciplines stay joined up rather than running in parallel.

items.question: What is a strategic growth consultancy?
items.answer: A strategic growth consultancy works at the level where direction is set, then carries that thinking through to delivery. Mackman Group does this as one integrated firm: brand and marketing, research and insight, and people and culture under one roof, rather than a lead consultant coordinating separate agencies. The result is strategy and delivery that stay joined up from the first conversation to the work that reaches the market.

items.question: What makes Mackman Group different from other consultancies?
items.answer: Most firms that describe themselves as integrated coordinate the model across several agencies. Mackman delivers it inside one firm, so strategy and delivery sit in the same place with no handover between them. That structure is the difference. It produces coherence first and speed as a consequence, and it works at proportionate cost against the multi-firm model it replaces.

items.question: Who does Mackman Group work with?
items.answer: Mackman works with ambitious, independently owned organisations, most often mid-market businesses with a long view and values that matter to how they grow. Many are owner-managed or family businesses, and a growing share are purpose-led. They tend to arrive when growth has moved ahead of how the organisation presents itself, or when a decision needs strategy and delivery to move as one.

items.question: Is Mackman Group a B Corp?
items.answer: Yes. Mackman Group is a certified B Corp, which means its social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency are independently verified. It is also the first-ever CIM Company Affiliate and an MRS Company Partner. These are Group-level credentials, held at the entity that genuinely carries them, and they sit behind the firm's commitment to growing organisations responsibly.

items.question: What does an integrated strategic consultancy actually do?
items.answer: An integrated strategic consultancy brings the disciplines that shape growth into one piece of work rather than running them separately. In practice, research informs brand and direction, brand strategy shapes how the organisation is expressed and how it positions itself as an employer, and people and culture make sure the organisation can deliver on the promise. The disciplines meet from the outset, not after the fact.

items.question: How does Mackman Group charge for its work?
items.answer: Mackman is a senior, selective firm rather than a volume business, so engagements are scoped to the decision in front of the client. Because strategy and delivery sit in one firm, clients do not pay several firms to manage the coordination between them. The framing is proportionate rather than cheap: senior thinking and the delivery that makes it real, from one place.

items.question: Where is Mackman Group based?
items.answer: Mackman Group is based in Suffolk and works with organisations across the UK. The firm has worked in partnership with clients who value substance over noise since 2003.
